description: Defines the CanvasFileWatcher class that manages file system event watching for a specific URL, utilizing SimpleFileWatcher and CoalescingFSEventsWatcher.

classes.name: CanvasFileWatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for watching file system changes at a specified URL and executing a callback on change.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes CanvasFileWatcher with a URL to watch and a callback to invoke upon changes.
